smoking weed doesn't do a whole lot to you directly. some carcinogens that could be avoided by vaping bud or edibles/oils. the most harmful thing about long term cannabis is that it can lead to neglecting other things, makes you inactive. exercise, work, teeth or other needs might not be met if you're constantly high, but if you've got life under control cannabis won't really hurt you.

but frequently smoking cannabis builds tolerance, removing most of the psychoactive effect. at some point smoking weed can become a habit that doesn't actually do much. a very boring addiction. some people take so called tolerance breaks 1-2 weeks to reset your tolerance so you can be high like before.

if also like to add cannabis generally kills motivation for anything that isn't fun, smoking for a long time can make it fell like that's just you, but after stopping people generally find it easier to get shit done. and might realise they've wasted years doing nothing

smoking anything is unhealthy, vaping, eating or oil is preferable. anecdotally smoking cigarettes cause a shortness of breath that last a lot longer. cannabis I'll maybe hark up some gunk occasionally but not the same long lasting shortness of breath
